_doc: Formula v2 class anchors (BALANCE_PIPELINE.md §5, DESIGN §12 second iteration). Each class prices by normalized deviation from its anchor: Cost = cost0 * (O/O0 + P/P0 + Q/Q0) / 3 — exact at the anchor. Anchors are MAINTAINER picks, validated by tools/balance/fit_class.py before sign-off. Classes without an entry keep the global Tiger formula.

mbt.comment: The Naxis Tiger Tank baseline (design 2026-07-11) — the global formula IS this anchor, kept for reference. O0=P0=Q0=cost0=800 by construction.
